correctness.rationale: The field model \(\mathbb F_{23}[u]/(u^2-5)\) is valid because 5 is nonsquare modulo 23. Independently of the package verifier, this audit checked that \(\beta=4+7u\) has order 24, reconstructed all eleven quadratic minimal polynomials, and multiplied the appropriate factors to recover all three displayed degree-20 generators. A fresh exhaustive enumeration of all \(23^4=279841\) messages for each generator reproduced every coefficient of all three weight enumerators. Independently projectivizing the 24 generator-matrix columns gave 8 points of multiplicity 3 with maximum line count 6, 12 points of multiplicity 2 with maximum line count 4, and 24 distinct points with maximum line count 2. The standard projective-system formula for generalized weights then gives exactly the three stated hierarchies. Distinct weight enumerators already force monomial inequivalence.
correctness.risk: The finite computations certify these three codes only; no formula for the whole source family is inferred.

Here they separate three natural codes that the defining source leaves indistinguishable at the basic \([n,k,d]\) level, and the support hierarchies quantify subcode support geometry relevant to higher-order erasure and wiretap behavior. final_claim: For the three dimension-four members \(I=\{1,2\},\{1,3\},\{2,3\}\) of the Zhang--Cao--Luo length-24 cyclic family over \(\mathbb F_{23}\), the exact weight enumerators are respectively \(1+220z^{12}+352z^{15}+12408z^{18}+70576z^{21}+196284z^{24}\), \(1+44z^{12}+792z^{16}+792z^{18}+27060z^{20}+86064z^{22}+165088z^{24}\), and \(1+44z^{12}+7920z^{20}+3168z^{21}+85800z^{22}+78672z^{23}+104236z^{24}\); their generalized Hamming-weight hierarchies are \((12,18,21,24)\), \((12,20,22,24)\), and \((12,22,23,24)\), so the three codes are pairwise monomially inequivalent.
